notes: Corrected: as soon as moved from added onto the waw of וַיִּגַּע (s022). The ASV writes one and and one subordinator for the two waws of וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּגַּע, so the count under rule 14 leaves neither side in surplus; a present connective morpheme takes the subordinator before a supplied-word analysis (rules 11, 55). The dropped הָלַךְ remains unrepresented.
The as of as they were burying stays added: no conjunction stands in that circumstantial clause, and the frame's that is written at the apodosis head and goes to the apodosis waw (rule 45).
